title: Bohot Yaad Aati Hai Beemar Sughra
body:
Behen Se Ye Ro Ro Ke Kehte The Sarwar…(x2)
<<MINI>>
Bohot Yaad Aati Hai Beemar Sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
1-behen Meri Haalat Bataaun Mai Kaise
mere Toote Dil Ko Manaaun Mai Kaise
lipat Ti Hai Seene Se Jab Bhi Sakina
<<MINI>>
bohot Yaad Aati Hai Beemar Sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
2-shabaahat Hai Sughra Me Maa Fatima Ki
nahi Saath Mere Watan Me Hai Wo Bhi
nigaaho Se Uthta Nahi Uska Chehra
<<MINI>>
bohot Yaad Aati Hai Beemar Sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
3-judaai Ka Gham Bhi Bada Dilhazeen Hai
hai Kubra Ki Shaadi Pa Sughra Nahi Hai
sajaaungi Mehendi Tha Armaan Uska
<<MINI>>
bohot Yaad Aati Hai Beemar Sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
4-mulakaat Akbar Ki Thi Jab Ajal Se
jigar Khoon Me Tar Tha Barchi Ke Phal Se
wo Khoon Behta Seena Sada De Raha Tha
<<MINI>>
bohot Yaad Aati Hai Beemar Sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
5-chida Ran Me Asghar Ka Pyasa Gala Jab
lahu Leke Chehre Pe Shah Ne Mala Tab
madine Ka Rukh Karke Bole Ye Maula
<<MINI>>
bohot Yaad Aati Hai Beemar Sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
6-tha Laaya Jise Kund Karke Sitamgar
chala Shah Ke Sookhe Gale Par Wo Khanjar
tadap Kar Ye Kehne Lage Shaahewala
<<MINI>>
bohot Yaad Aati Hai Beemar Sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
7-nahi Chain Mujhko Hai Ab Waqt E Rehlat
dikhado Mujhe Uski Ek Bar Surat
kaha Roke Akbar Ne Aye Mere Baba
<<MINI>>
bohot Yaad Aati Hai Beemar Sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
8-hai Farte Azaa Me Wo Masoom Meri
mera Dil Ye Sunta Hai Har Aah Uski
rulata Hai Mujhko Tadapna Ye Uska
<<MINI>>
bohot Yaad Aati Hai Beemar Sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
9- Behen Betiya Hai Janaze Ki Zeenat
nahi Saath Sughra Hai Kaisi Qayamat
zameen Se Uthne Ko Hai Mera Saaya
<<MINI>>
bohot Yaad Aati Hai Beemar Sughra
<<DIVIDER>>
10-shahedeen Pe Thi Karabala Me Qayamat aur Us Par Thi Beemar Beti Ki Furqat
fasi Ab Ye Sunte Hee Purdard Roya
<<MINI>>
bohot Yaad Aati Hai Beemar Sughra
